regime_context: This is a narrow, dominant ''one-narrative'' tape: only Coal and Banks are eligible (2/22 themes). Coal leads at rank 1 with very poor durability (0.48), mean-revert Hurst tag, low breadth (0.30) and negative 10-day return — a thin, top-forming leadership profile. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT help on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), and this desk's own track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.34 on 98 calls. That combination demands humility and very low default conviction; no theme earns a high-conviction directional call today.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks vs Coal for a CONFIRMED handoff: if Banks' score closes the 0.027 margin and moves decisively above Coal while Coal's breadth stays below 0.40 for two consecutive weeks, the one-narrative leadership has rotated. If instead Coal's breadth recovers above 0.50 and it holds rank 1 for four straight weeks, the rotation hypothesis retires and Coal is simply re-asserting.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible theme with healthy trend texture: durability_bar 0.80 (trend tag), breadth 0.778 (broad leadership, not a one-name spike) and positive momentum score. While Coal holds the top rank, it shows the opposite profile (low breadth, low durability, negative r10). The trend-gate eligibility leg is the only detector leg with any validated drawdown edge, but that edge explicitly failed on this market's history, so the read is conditional: favour the highest-durability eligible theme, aware the gate itself is experimental here.
evidence: rank 2, score 1.11 — within margin (0.027) of leader Coal
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z=1.77, crowded=true), and a 1.77 z-score on a thin China tape often marks an attention peak rather than fresh accumulation — reflexivity may mean limited incremental buyers left.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is rank 1 but the detector legs all flash fragility, not strength: durability below the 0.5 threshold, Hurst tag says mean-revert, breadth is a thin 0.30, and the 10-day return is actually negative (-0.0022). The one-narrative / low-absorption read (absorption 0.33) says the market is concentrated in a leadership theme that already looks tired. Avoid chasing the leader.
theses.dissent: Coal may still be the only narrative with real policy/earnings support in a hard-to-short A-share market, and mean-revert tags can stay 'mean-reverting' upward into a final leg — avoiding it could miss the strongest episode of the move.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS makes a new 60-day high with breadth expanding above 0.55 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar sits deep in the negative-momentum cohort (score -0.522, rank 20/22) and is the least crowded theme in the entire set (crowding_z=-2.22). On a tape where the only validated edge is drawdown avoidance, a theme that is both losing momentum and abandoned by flow offers no asymmetry. Underweight is a relative judgement, not a short.
evidence: crowding_z=-2.22 (lowest in the set — flow has left)
theses.dissent: Extremely negative crowding_z can mark capitulation — if policy or subsidy news hits, a deserted theme can bounce hardest on any inflow.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 6% over a rolling 20-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
